# RoadOne acquires Higgins Transport Service, expanding southeast logistics presence 

Aug 18, 2026

RoadOne IntermodaLogistics announces the acquisition of Higgins Transport Service LLC, a Charleston, South Carolina-based agent of Wall Street Intermodal that provides port drayage and intermodal freight transportation services.

The acquisition expands RoadOne’s drayage and intermodal capacity in the Charleston market, further strengthening the company’s ability to serve importers, exporters, retailers and manufacturers moving freight through one of the Southeast’s most important global trade gateways. In addition to bringing experienced leadership to the market, RoadOne will add 15 drivers to its Charleston operations, strengthening local transportation capacity and complementing the company’s growing warehousing and distribution capabilities across the region.

Justin Higgins, owner of Higgins Transport Service, stated, “When you work in this industry, you quickly learn who the major players are, and RoadOne IntermodaLogistics is a true leader in our space. Joining their team through this acquisition is an incredible milestone for us. We are proud to have built an operation that attracted a partner like RoadOne, and we are excited about what the future holds as we leverage RoadOne’s national platform to serve our clients and drive future growth.”

RoadOne has demonstrated a strong commitment to the Charleston market over the last several years and sees significant long-term growth potential in the region, driven by its deep-water port and fast-growing population. RoadOne has recently opened a 384,000-square-foot facility in Summerville, South Carolina, strategically located near the Port of Charleston to support the movement, storage and distribution of goods throughout the Southeast. Beginning in 2027, RoadOne plans to develop a second 279,700-square-foot warehouse on the property, further expanding its capacity and logistics capabilities in the region.

RoadOne Executive Vice President JC Carruthers said, “Providing comprehensive, reliable and efficient distribution and logistics services throughout the U.S. is our goal, and we have been particularly focused on expanding our presence in Charleston and throughout the Southeast. The addition of Higgins Transport Service strengthens our commitment to providing unmatched service throughout the Southeast global trade corridor and supporting all of our customers’ supply chain needs. We’re thrilled to have Justin and the team join the RoadOne family.”

This acquisition is part of RoadOne’s ongoing investment in its national network and its strategy of combining local market expertise with expanded transportation, warehousing and logistics capabilities. With a growing presence in key logistics markets throughout the U.S., RoadOne provides customers with greater efficiency, capacity and connectivity
